_comment: FY2025 grounded actuals (bank schema). Source: SNB FY2025 results, 27-Jan-2026 (alahli.com / Saudi Exchange), confirmed by Sahm Capital / Saudi Standard. Net profit attributable to shareholders SAR 25.013bn (+18.0% YoY from 21.193bn); EPS SAR 4.04 (vs 3.44). Total operating income SAR 39.195bn (+8.8%); net special commission income (NII) SAR 29.155bn (financing 27.541 + investment 1.614); non-interest income derived as op income - NII = 10.040bn. Customer deposits SAR 636.094bn (+9.7%); total assets SAR 1.210trn (+9.6%); financing+investment portfolio SAR 729.311bn (+11.5%, combined — not pure net loans, so omitted). ROE / CAR / DPS not in the results announcement.
